Website describes an architectural design firm focused on K-12 education projects, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' contracts for architectural services
research.notes: Web search budget was exhausted, so no registry lookup (CA SOS, SAM.gov) was done; legal name and registry IDs left null. Website domain was found by direct fetch, not search; its content matches the agenda's Oakland/San Francisco locations and K-12 work. The site does not mention OUSD. Phone and address are the Oakland office; the site does not name a headquarters or a general email.

profile.summary: DSK Architects is an architectural design firm with offices in Oakland, San Francisco, San Luis Obispo and Los Angeles, California. Its work includes K-12 schools, higher education, healthcare, commercial and interior design projects.

sources.title: dsk architects | Architectural Design | Bay Area | California | SF, LA, PL, SLO

review.notes: The firm's site shows Oakland (1901 Harrison St., Suite 1320, phone 510.686.6595) and San Francisco offices, K-12 and other listed project types, and a West Oakland Middle School facade project that matches an OUSD agenda project. The summary, address, phone and website are all supported, and the summary is neutral.
